## Outcome

Describe intended behavior and affected contract requirement IDs, or explain why
contracts are unchanged. Keep proposed intent separate from existing approvals.

## Verification

List commands actually run, environment, results, and remaining gaps. Use a
Conventional Commit PR title; retain breaking intent when squash merging.

## Security Review

- [ ] Reviewed workflow/action, dependency, Docker, release-config and validation-script changes if applicable.
- [ ] No secrets or new publishing permissions in untrusted validation.
- [ ] Compatibility/migration, keyboard/mobile/error behavior considered where applicable.
